_comment: Roles for Bob. Copy to roles.json (gitignored, or point BOB_ROLES_FILE at another path) and edit. A chat in chat-config.json gets "roles": [...] instead of a hand-written "mcp" list; its access is the union of the roles' "access" plus the chat's "add_groups" minus its "remove_groups". A chat with "external_chat": true never gets a group flagged "team_only". The role "assistant" is required: it means every default group (the old "mcp": null). "knowledge" entries: "wiring" is "prompt" (appended to the system prompt of chats with the role), "tool" (read by a tool on request) or "code" (wired in the code, described here only). "image" is a file name from scripts/bob_panel/static/bob/ (without .svg) - the role's picture in the panel. The file is read on every reply, so a change applies immediately. Files written with the older Polish keys still load.
